Season 26 objective timers and role quest facts (reference/shared.json)

phases.label: Levels 1-3
goals: Farm safely with Infected Bonesaw and keep your health high; you scale, they don't.
Last-hit with Q so it heals you back, and never miss it into an empty lane.
Reach level 3 without a big trade and with a stable wave.
do: Start Doran's Helm and a Health Potion; take Grasp of the Undying.
Have Q, E and W by level 3 and max Q first (see the Build tab); Q is your farm, poke and heal.
Use Infected Bonesaw on the enemy when it also hits a minion or when they walk up to last-hit.
Q a caster minion to heal and keep the wave near your tower if the enemy is ranged.
Trade only for a short W and E burst when the enemy has just used his key skill.
dont: Don't spam Q at range; it costs health and a miss hurts you more than them.
Don't leave W on when nothing is hitting you; it also costs current health.
Don't chase a retreating enemy under their tower at low health.
ifAhead: Q-poke him off every last-hit and shove the wave to take plates; don't over-chase.
Shove only when the enemy jungler showed on the other side of the map.
ifEven: Farm with Q, trade only when they step up for a last-hit, and keep the wave near the middle.
Check where the enemy jungler is before every trade.
ifBehind: Farm under your tower with Q and keep your health above half; stay alive to scale.
Never fight without health; Mundo needs levels, not kills.

phases.label: Levels 4-5
goals: Recall on a crashed wave for your first health items and come back without losing a wave.
Keep CS and XP even so the role quest and level 6 arrive on time.
Stay alive for the 5:00 dragon window; don't take unnecessary fights.
do: Crash the wave before you recall so you lose no minions and no experience.
Buy Giant's Belt (or the best health component you can afford) with your first back.
Trade with Q slow, auto, E, then W when the enemy commits to hitting you; heal by hitting champions and monsters with Q.
Ward the river or tri-brush before you push past the middle.
dont: Don't take extended fights with low health; your Q costs health.
Don't recall with the wave pushing against you.
ifAhead: Freeze near your tower to deny CS or crash the wave for plates, then recall for your first item.
Group with your jungler for dragon only if the wave is crashed.
ifEven: Slow push, farm to a crash, recall for health components, and stay level with them.
Farm safely; Mundo out-scales most top laners.
ifBehind: Keep the wave near your tower and only last-hit; W and the passive canister keep you healthy.
Buy health and wait for level 6; avoid 50/50 fights.

phases.label: Level 6 to first item
goals: Use Maximum Dosage as a fight tool: its heal and movement speed win extended fights.
Finish Heartsteel (your first big spike) and finish the top role quest around 12:30.
Hold your lane and farm; join the 8:00 Voidgrubs only if the wave is crashed first.
do: Fight with R when the enemy is close: it heals more the more health you miss, so cast it at mid HP, not at the last second.
Use E, W and Q together: E on the champion, W to absorb damage, Q to slow them.
Push the wave, then join grubs at 8:00 with your jungler.
Farm top to finish the quest; out-of-lane points count much less early.
dont: Don't use R at full health with nobody near you; it heals a percentage of missing health and gets more with enemies nearby.
Don't roam before the wave is crashed; it slows your quest and loses plates.
Don't overextend without vision when the enemy jungler is around.
ifAhead: All-in with R and take plates, then the turret; you are hard to kill with Heartsteel.
Stay top and keep pushing; don't give free farm back.
ifEven: Push for priority, help at grubs, and farm safely to Heartsteel.
Fight only when your Q is up and you have health; R makes long trades in your favor.
ifBehind: Farm safely toward Heartsteel; your spike is item-based, not level-based.
Keep vision on your side and don't contest grubs without priority.

phases.label: First item to ~14 minutes
goals: Use Heartsteel stacks and your health to win lane or take the turret.
Buy Boots of Swiftness (or Plated Steelcaps against auto-attackers) and start Warmog's Armor.
Set up the 15:00 Rift Herald and use your quest Teleport to swing plays.
do: Hit Heartsteel's passive on champions and let your health pool grow; stack it on the enemy laner every time you walk up to him.
Push turrets with your minions; melee champions deal 20% more damage to turrets.
Hold Teleport for dragon fights or to rejoin lane after a recall.
Push top before herald so you arrive first.
dont: Don't TP into a fight that will be over before you land.
Don't leave the wave pushing into you before an objective.
ifAhead: Take the tower (first turret is worth +300g) and start looking for the next objective.
Invade or hold vision around top-side jungle with your jungler.
ifEven: Push top, then help at herald or dragon.
Duel when your Q is up; most top laners can't kill you with Heartsteel and Warmog's Armor.
ifBehind: Farm safely and finish Warmog's Armor; don't fight the enemy top alone yet.
Use Teleport to help your team win bot-side fights instead.

phases.label: Midgame
goals: Split push a side lane and front-line at objectives; you win by being too tanky to kill.
Build Warmog's Armor, then Titanic Hydra or Spirit Visage depending on the enemy.
Plan around Baron at 20:00 and dragons with TP up.
do: Push the lane across the map from the next objective and be ready to TP or walk back.
Take plates on inner and inhibitor turrets; they stay up permanently.
When Warmog's Armor is active (about 2000 bonus health), walk in and take fights; you out-sustain most damage.
Buy Spirit Visage when the enemy team is mostly magic damage or has heavy healing on you, otherwise Titanic Hydra.
dont: Don't split push without vision when three or more enemies are missing.
Don't stay split while your team fights 4v5 at Baron or Soul with no TP.
ifAhead: Draw two or more enemies to you, or take turrets for free.
Group with your team for Baron at 20:00 and take the front-line.
ifEven: Side lane with TP up, then join fights at objectives.
Rotate early to the side of the map with the next objective.
ifBehind: Farm safe side waves and finish Warmog's Armor before you fight.
Group before objectives and play the front-line with R up.

phases.label: Lategame
goals: Front-line every fight with R up and walk at the carries; you ignore most of their CC and burst.
Split push when your team can hold, forcing two enemies to answer.
Don't get caught alone; death timers are long now.
do: Keep side waves pushed while Baron or Elder is up so your team has minion pressure.
Use Q to slow and heal, W to soak damage, and R when the enemies are on you.
Add defense (Thornmail, Randuin's Omen or Dead Man's Plate) if the enemy team has a fed carry.
Play near the side of the map with the next objective so you can get there in time.
dont: Don't run past the front line at full CC; wait for the enemy to spend it first, then engage.
ifAhead: 1v1 anyone; take inhibitors with your team and end with Baron.
Split while your team holds mid; answer only for objectives.
ifEven: Group for Elder or Baron and walk in first with R.
Split only when your TP is up or your team can safely wait.
ifBehind: Group with your team and stay in front; your health pool still makes you a great tank.
Don't split alone; look for picks on lone side laners from brush instead.

trading: Infected Bonesaw is your poke: 20-30% of current health, minimum damage 80-280, and it slows for 2 seconds. Q costs health, so land it.
Q from range when it will hit both a minion and the enemy; you heal 100% of the health cost on champions and monsters, 50% on minions.
Q on cooldown is every 4 seconds; if the enemy dodges it, back off and wait rather than throw a second one.
Short trade: Q to slow, auto with E (the empowered auto), then W to soak damage; step out and repeat when the enemy walks up to last-hit.
W stores damage and heals 50% of it (100% if you hit a champion or large monster); detonate on the enemy with a second W press at the end.
W costs 8% of your current health: don't use it below 25% health or when nothing is hitting you.
Level 6 with R makes long trades in your favor: R heals over 10 seconds and gives movement speed.
Never trade into a champion who beats you in all-ins early (for example Gwen, Aatrox or Yone) unless you have levels and R.
waveManagement: Farm with Q under your tower against ranged and skirmisher matchups; keep the wave near your side.
Slow push into a big wave and crash it before every recall so you lose no minions.
Crash before every objective (5:00 dragon, 8:00 grubs, 15:00 herald, 20:00 Baron) so you arrive first.
When ahead, freeze near your tower or crash into the turret for plates; plates no longer fall at 14:00.
Farm in top lane to finish the role quest faster: 2 points per minion and 40 per plate in top.
Use Q to last-hit cannon minions from range; it heals you every time.

when: After Heartsteel and Warmog's Armor, when you win a 1v1 against whoever usually answers.
When your team can safely play 4v4 or hold mid without you.
When the next objective is on the other side of the map and your TP is up.
rules: Push the lane opposite the next objective: if Baron is up and TP is ready, split bot; if TP is down, split top.
Look at the map: if 3 or more enemies are missing, back off to a safe spot.
If one enemy comes, duel them with Q, E and W; if two come, walk away and ping your team to take an objective.
Keep a ward near your lane so you can see them coming and walk out of range.
Hit the turret with your minions and use Q on minions to heal while you push.
tpUsage: Save TP for dragon, herald or Baron fights instead of walking back to lane.
TP to a ward or minion on a flank, not straight in front of the enemy team.
After the quest you get a free Teleport (390s cooldown) or, if you took Teleport, an upgraded TP (300-210s); plan splits around it.
Don't TP into a fight that will be over before you land, and make sure you'll actually reach the enemy.

teamfight.role: Front-line tank and engage: walk in first with R up, absorb damage with W, slow with Q, and ignore most crowd control (the passive grants immunity to the next immobilizing effect when it is up).
rules: Don't Q blind into a fight; wait until you can hit a champion so you heal.
Use W to absorb burst as the fight starts, then detonate it on the enemies near you.
Cast R once enemies are on you or in range: its heal grows with more enemy champions nearby.
Walk at the enemy carries after their key CC is used; don't run in first against a full comp of hard CC.
Against heavy AD, buy Thornmail or Randuin's Omen; against heavy AP, Spirit Visage.
targetPriority: Carries you can reach: the ADC or mid laner in range of Q and E.
Whoever is closest and dealing the most damage to your team.
Otherwise the closest enemy to your allies; Q them to slow and peel.

objectives: Dragon spawns at 5:00 (5:00 respawn); Soul needs 4 drakes, and Elder comes 6:00 later. Push top first so you can TP bot.
Voidgrubs: one camp of 3 at 8:00, despawns 14:45. Crash the wave and help take them; each grub adds bonus turret damage.
Rift Herald: once at 15:00, despawns 19:45. Use the Eye of the Herald on a top turret when you can.
Baron: 20:00, then 6:00 after each kill. Be near it with R up and your team grouped; don't be dead or far away at 20:00.
Atakhan was removed in 2026; plan around dragon and Baron at 20:00 instead.
Plates are permanent and on inner and inhibitor turrets too. Every turret hit matters for Mundo (melee bonus 20%).
Q monsters for sustain: Q heals 100% on large monsters, but its damage against monsters is capped (250-550).
mechanics: Q Infected Bonesaw costs 50-90 health and heals 100% of that if it hits a champion or monster (50% on minions).
W Heart Zapper stores 80-95% of damage taken for up to 3 seconds and heals 50% of it (100% on champion or large monster hit); press it again to detonate.
E Blunt Force Trauma gives bonus damage from your max health; the empowered auto knocks back killed targets.
R Maximum Dosage: 120 second cooldown, 10 seconds, heals over time, gives 15-35% movement speed, and +5% extra per enemy champion nearby at rank 3.
Passive Goes Where He Pleases: immune to the next immobilizing effect; pick up the canister to heal 4% max health and reduce the cooldown.
Your passive also gives health regeneration that grows with level (0.4% to 2.3% of max health every 5 seconds); items with bonus health scale it.
Warmog's Armor needs about 2000 bonus health for its regeneration; count your health runes and Doran's Shield/Helm toward it.
Q and E monster damage caps were reduced in V26.08; don't rely on burst against big monsters.

recallTimings.buy: Giant's Belt (or a Doran's item plus Health Potions if you are short)
recallTimings.note: Your first back: health components toward Heartsteel. Crash the wave first.

recallTimings.buy: Kindlegem or Giant's Belt toward Heartsteel plus a Control Ward
recallTimings.note: Heartsteel is your first big spike.
Good after a kill or a long lane stay.

recallTimings.buy: Boots of Swiftness (or Plated Steelcaps vs auto-attackers)
recallTimings.note: Buy after Heartsteel; Boots of Swiftness is the most common pick.
Second item; reach about 2000 bonus health.
Third item; pair with Titanic Hydra or Spirit Visage.

recallTimings.buy: Long Sword or Boots + Control Ward
recallTimings.note: Only if you have to recall early.

commonMistakes: Throwing Infected Bonesaw at nothing; every miss costs health and cooldown.
Leaving Heart Zapper on with no damage coming in; it drains your current health.
Fighting without enough health; Mundo needs a healthy pool to scale.
Using Maximum Dosage at full health with no enemy nearby; you waste its heal.
Splitting without vision or TP while the enemy starts Baron or Soul.
Running past the front line into a full CC team instead of waiting for it to be used.
Buying damage items too early; health first, then Titanic Hydra.

enemy_laner_dead: Push the wave into their turret and take plates.
Recall after crashing if you need items, or help your jungler at the next objective.
you_died_to_gank: Ward the river or tri-brush and keep the wave closer to your tower.
Track the enemy jungler; keep your health high and your passive canister up.
you_died_solo: Keep your health above half before you fight; don't trade into their power spike.
Farm safely under tower and play for Heartsteel and level 6.
opp_level_lead: They're a level up; don't fight until you catch up.
Farm safely with Q under tower.
you_level_lead: You're a level up; take a Q, E and W trade before they catch up.
you_hit_level_2_first: Level 2 first: Q the enemy, auto with E and step out.
you_hit_6: Maximum Dosage ready: long trades now favor you. Cast R at half HP, not at the last second.
Watch for the enemy jungler before you commit.
first_item_done: Heartsteel done: push and fight with your health pool; buy Boots of Swiftness next.
second_item_done: Two items: walk in at fights and split push a side lane when your team is grouped.
three_items_done: Three items: you're a walking tank; force two enemies to answer you or front-line with R.
you_are_fed: Stay top and keep your lead: crash waves, take turrets, and force them to send two.
Don't overextend without vision; your bounty is high.
you_are_behind: Farm safely and don't fight; Mundo scales well into the late game.
Group before objectives and front-line instead of splitting alone.
enemy_laner_fed: Don't 1v1 them; freeze near your tower and ask your jungler for help.
Build defense early (Plated Steelcaps or Thornmail) and farm to your late game.
enemy_team_numbers_down: You have more players; push a turret or take the next objective now.
Crash your wave on the way.
your_team_numbers_down: Your team is down players; don't fight. Clear waves under your turret and wait.
baron_up_soon: Baron soon: push your side lane now so you can join or split opposite with TP up.
If your TP is down, split top so you can walk to Baron.
dragon_up_soon: Dragon soon: crash top and keep TP ready to join bot.
If you can't make it, push top to pull an enemy away.
grubs_soon: Grubs at 8:00: crash your wave and help your jungler take them.
Don't go if the enemy top and jungler get there first.
herald_soon: Herald at 15:00: push top first, then help take it and use the Eye of the Herald on a top turret.
enemy_jungler_ganked_top_repeatedly: Keep the wave near your tower and ward the river and tri-brush.
Keep your health high and let your passive canister and W cover the gank.
long_death_timers: Death timers are long: don't split without vision; one death can lose Baron or the game.
Group near the objective or split with TP up.
enemy_has_heavy_healing: Heavy healing: buy Thornmail for Grievous Wounds.
Fight them in long trades with R; your sustain outlasts theirs once they are cut.
enemy_heavy_ap: Heavy AP: buy Spirit Visage and Mercury's Treads.
Use W to absorb their burst and heal back.
enemy_heavy_ad: Heavy AD: Plated Steelcaps and Thornmail or Randuin's Omen.
Use W when their ADC or auto-attackers engage you.
enemy_many_tanks: Many tanks: Titanic Hydra and your max-health damage from E are good against them.
Split push so they have to send a tank to you, and take turrets.
enemy_heavy_cc: Heavy CC: the passive blocks the first immobilizing effect; use it on their best engage.
Wait for the key CC to be spent, then walk in with R.
turret_lost: Your turret is down: don't push without vision; play side lanes near your next turret.
Move to a safer lane or group with your team.
enemy_turret_taken: Turret taken: the map is open, so move to the next side lane or objective.
Keep hitting their inner turrets; plates stay up and pay out.
